workflow.title: Review Mac build artifacts before a MangoDisk cleanup
workflow.primaryIntent: Decide whether a developer-cache/project-artifact result is rebuildable before confirming it, especially when using custom log rules.
workflow.description: Use MangoDisk's documented scan and review flow to distinguish rebuildable project output from files you should keep. This is a source-based guide, not a hands-on cleanup test.
outline: Open with decision: rebuild cost and ownership matter more than size; official app visual after lead once cleared
Standard Scan versus chosen disks: scope affects what appears (C05/C06)
Custom log patterns: a name/time match does not establish disposability (C06)
Review category, full path, app closure warnings, selected total and backup before confirmation (C06/C09)
Optional AI explains consequences, not personal-file value or cleanup authorization (C08)
Recurring investigations: bounded Breathing Room discussion with affiliation and preview/hosted caveats (B01/B02); current Space example preview as second visual
workflow.interactionPass: Plan a non-executing checklist: identify owner, source-versus-generated, ability/cost to rebuild, backup, affected apps, deletion method. Unknown answer means leave unselected. No filesystem access or deletion widget.
workflow.distinctness: A pre-deletion decision workflow for project build output/custom rules, not an expanded generic feature comparison. No arbitrary code demo, claims of tested outcomes, padding or fabricated FAQ.

comparison.title: MangoDisk vs Breathing Room: cleanup review or recurring care?
comparison.primaryIntent: Choose between a broad scan/review utility and Breathing Room's preview investigation/saved-approval care model, without denying MangoDisk monitoring or AI.
mangodiskAdvantages: Documented macOS 12.5+ requirement and Windows/Linux distribution, unlike Mac-only Breathing Room
Explicit treemap/sunburst, duplicate and uninstall workflows in official documentation
Free desktop offer, inspectable GPL code, Mac CLI and optional provider-configurable AI explanations
mangodiskTradeoffs: Permanent deletion is documented for several views; backup and manual review matter
Exact free AI quota is not published in inspected guide; custom providers may charge
Helper grouping, recurring-growth and scheduled-approval parity not verified; unknown is not absence
comparison.breathingRoomFit: Editorial judgment: readers investigating recurring growth and saved exact approvals may consider Breathing Room, which we build, subject to preview, runtime, hosted-data and paid-service caveats. Not a measured superiority claim.
breathingRoomTradeoffs: macOS 13+ only in verified register; Python 3.10+ dependency
Hosted AI requires internet/authentication; AI Care advertised subscription and app-running daily-care constraint
